title: Delta Air Lines: July 2026 Air Travel Consumer Report: May 2026 Operating and Complaint Data
summary: DOT's July 2026 report supplies May 2026 operating-carrier delay causes plus brand-level complaint-category counts. Entity test: The repeat record shows movement across several reported categories but cannot isolate one explanation or represent a full-year outcome.
key_findings: The report provides a later compatible monthly operating denominator and a separate complaint denominator for Delta, Southwest, and United.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests delay-cause mix, network or airport exposure, customer-service evidence, and partner-operation attribution.
Compatibility: Same reporting operating carrier and monthly delay table; brand-level complaints may include partner-operated flights and use a separate denominator.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: Monthly operating percentages and raw brand-level complaint counts use different denominators and must not be combined into a service score.
Official common-table observations; causal attribution and commitment delivery remain unverified.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
